face_common: Create a pixel-game FACIAL EXPRESSION PATCH atlas for a seated orange chibi cat. First attached image is the exact central face patch reference (no ears/body); second image is the complete character for identity only. Output 12 chronological expression frames in 4 columns x 3 rows of equal square cells, no gutters, borders, labels or text. Do NOT draw a whole cat, head outline, ears, forehead stripes, body, paws or furniture. Each cell contains only the same central rectangular facial skin patch with eyebrows, two brown eyes, cream muzzle, pink nose and tiny mouth, matching the cropped reference colors and stepped pixels. Within every square cell the facial patch fills x=5..95%, y=20..80%, including opaque orange skin to cover the original eyes; transparent margins elsewhere. Straight front view only. Keep face size, eye sockets, nose and muzzle positions IDENTICAL in all frames; only eyelids, pupils and mouth expression change. No head motion, tilt, scaling, cheek outline movement, jitter, exaggerated blush, tears, sweat, punctuation or external effects. The complete body and outer head will be a single fixed PNG in the program, so this is just a facial replacement patch. Natural small expressions, clear at low resolution. Real transparency outside each patch.

faces.working: WORKING expression: attentive and focused, brown eyes looking slightly down at the keyboard, tiny neutral determined mouth. Twelve frames: 1-4 focused open eyes, 5 half blink, 6 closed blink, 7 open again, 8-12 attentive open eyes. Tiny pupil/eyelid variations only, no moving face. Finish near frame 1. Do not draw keyboard or typing hands in this face asset.
faces.idle: IDLE / READY expression: relaxed and friendly, gentle tiny smile, calm open brown eyes; 1-4 open, 5-7 one slow soft blink, 8-12 reopen with a mild cheerful smile. No sleeping, no body breathing, yawning, head bob or face deformation. The cat remains seated and perfectly still, hands will be resting.
faces.syncing: SYNCING / WAITING expression: patient, attentive wait; mouth is a small flat relaxed curve, eyes look slightly to one side then back without changing eye socket positions. Frames 1-3 wait focused, 4-5 pupils glance, 6 return, 7-8 blink, 9-12 settle. No alarm or typing face; no head turn, no device or loading icons.
faces.error: ERROR expression: mildly concerned but cute, inward raised eyebrows, worried brown eyes and a tiny worried downturned mouth. Eyes make a brief small blink in frames 6-7 then return to worried attention. Keep eye sockets and whole face fixed. No panic, crying, tears, injuries, shaking, sweat, red overlays, exclamation icons or changing head size. Concerned expression only.

hands: Generate a character-only orange-cat TYPING PAWS animation atlas. Reference image is the orange chibi cat identity; orange fur, dark-brown stepped pixel outline, NO white socks. Exactly 12 consecutive frames, 4 columns by 3 rows equal square cells, real transparent background, no labels or furniture. EACH cell has exactly TWO separate visible hand-and-short-forearm regions: LEFT paw centered x=25%, RIGHT paw centered x=75%, both around y=55%. Each paw including short forearm fills about 24% of cell width, y=25..75%; transparent everywhere else. Front-facing view looking slightly down at paws resting on a horizontal keyboard surface (the keyboard is not drawn). Palms down, short rounded furry hands, subtle dark finger/toe separations, forearms lead upward toward the hidden seated body. Do not draw raised fists, claws, arms detached in impossible poses, cat head, body, desk, keyboard, monitor, text or icons. This is an overlay for a STATIC seated cat behind a STATIC monitor; the connecting arms are occluded by that monitor in the program. In the 12-frame loop alternate small key presses: left paw presses for 1-3 while right rests, both rest 4, right presses 5-7, both rest 8, left presses 9-10, right presses 11, both relax 12 near frame1. Only finger curl and a tiny downward press vary; both paws keep their same size and x/y contact centers in all cells. No large waving or moving arms. Consistent warm orange skin/fur and brown outline with chunky flat pixel clusters, no smooth shaded 3D. Real alpha transparency.
